judgement.reason: Coolify is a Laravel web app on PostgreSQL and Redis; running the s6 services as separate workers is a contained change, so DEPLOYABLE_WITH_CHANGES holds.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported container setup: docker/production/Dockerfile runs s6-overlay with 4 long-running services (horizon, reverb, scheduler-worker, terminal-server) in one container. Deployz runs one web process and declared workers as separate services.
reviews.reason: The shown Dockerfile lines use an s6-overlay based serversideup image and build terminal dependencies, and nothing shown proves that the extra services (horizon, reverb, scheduler, terminal server) are optional or could be run as separate workers.
